description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for health checks in the Gateway service, including timeout durations and cluster role expectations.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Interface providing health check configuration methods for the Gateway service.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckConfigValue
classes.description: Enum representing default configuration values for health check parameters.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig.ClusterRolesConfig
classes.description: Nested interface defining cluster role related health check configurations.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig.ClusterRolesConfig.ClusterRolesConfigValue
classes.description: Enum representing default configuration values for cluster roles settings.

methods.name: getServiceTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration used for health checks of individual services.

methods.name: getClusterRolesConfig
methods.description: Returns the cluster roles configuration settings for health checks.
